author: Ryan_014
quote: This is the worst game ever. The missions just keep getting worse—each one more repulsive than the last. The graphics don’t match what was shown in the promotional trailers, and the animations are poor. On top of that, there are an indescribable number of technical glitches. Is this really the game the world has been waiting 13 years for—a piece of trash like this? And the story is terrible, too—I won’t even go into the details.
